claim_text:
Capricorn prioritises the use of gas rather than diesel as the main
energy source at KGP, to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, with
the same strategy planned for MGGP.
metric_name: Diesel energy consumption; Liquified Natural Gas energy consumption
label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: The claim says gas is prioritised over diesel as the main energy source at KGP, but the energy table shows diesel consumption at KGP exceeded LNG consumption in FY25.
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that gas is prioritised over diesel as the main energy source at KGP (and that the same strategy is planned for MGGP) in order to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. The provided evidence only gives energy consumption figures for diesel (911,315 GJ) and liquified natural gas (879,181 GJ) without identifying KGP or MGGP, without stating which fuel is the “main” energy source, and without any greenhouse-gas emissions data or demonstrated emissions reduction attributable to fuel switching. The numbers shown also do not substantiate “gas rather than diesel as the main energy source” because diesel consumption is higher than LNG in the provided figures, and there is no evidence about any planned strategy for MGGP.
